verses.en: Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the LORD God had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?
verses.pt: Porém a serpente era astuta, mais que todos os animais do campo que o SENHOR Deus havia feito. E ela disse à mulher: Deus vos disse: Não comais de toda árvore do jardim?
verses.en_web: Now the serpent was more subtle than any animal of the field which Yahweh God had made. He said to the woman, “Has God really said, ‘You shall not eat of any tree of the garden?’”
verses.en_bbe: Now the snake was wiser than any beast of the field which the Lord God had made. And he said to the woman, Has God truly said that you may not take of the fruit of any tree in the garden?

verses.en: And the woman said unto the serpent, We may eat of the fruit of the trees of the garden:
verses.pt: E a mulher respondeu à serpente: Do fruto das árvores do jardim podemos comer;
verses.en_web: The woman said to the serpent, “We may eat fruit from the trees of the garden,
verses.en_bbe: And the woman said, We may take of the fruit of the trees in the garden:

verses.en: But of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.
verses.pt: mas do fruto da árvore que está no meio do jardim, Deus disse: Não comereis dele, nem o tocareis, para que não morrais.
verses.en_web: but not the fruit of the tree which is in the middle of the garden. God has said, ‘You shall not eat of it. You shall not touch it, lest you die.’”
verses.en_bbe: But of the fruit of the tree in the middle of the garden, God has said, If you take of it or put your hands on it, death will come to you.

verses.en: And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:
verses.pt: Então a serpente disse à mulher: Não morrereis;
verses.en_web: The serpent said to the woman, “You won’t really die,
verses.en_bbe: And the snake said, Death will not certainly come to you:

verses.en: For God doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.
verses.pt: Mas Deus sabe que no dia que comerdes dele, vossos olhos serão abertos, e sereis como deuses, sabendo o bem e o mal.
verses.en_web: for God knows that in the day you eat it, your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.”
verses.en_bbe: For God sees that on the day when you take of its fruit, your eyes will be open, and you will be as gods, having knowledge of good and evil.

verses.en: And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make one wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.
verses.pt: E a mulher viu que a árvore era boa para se comer, agradável aos olhos, e árvore desejável para se obter conhecimento. E ela tomou de seu fruto, e comeu; e deu também ao seu marido com ela, e ele comeu.
verses.en_web: When the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was a delight to the eyes, and that the tree was to be desired to make one wise, she took some of its fruit, and ate; and she gave some to her husband with her, and he ate it, too.
verses.en_bbe: And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and a delight to the eyes, and to be desired to make one wise, she took of its fruit, and gave it to her husband.

verses.en: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.
verses.pt: E foram abertos os olhos de ambos, e conheceram que estavam nus. Então coseram folhas de figueira, e fizeram para si aventais.
verses.en_web: Their eyes were opened, and they both knew that they were naked. They sewed fig leaves together, and made coverings for themselves.
verses.en_bbe: And their eyes were open and they were conscious that they had no clothing and they made themselves coats of leaves stitched together.

verses.en: And they heard the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God amongst the trees of the garden.
verses.pt: E ouviram a voz do SENHOR Deus, que passeava no jardim à brisa do dia; e o homem e sua mulher esconderam-se da presença do SENHOR Deus entre as árvores do jardim.
verses.en_web: They heard Yahweh God’s voice walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of Yahweh God among the trees of the garden.
verses.en_bbe: And there came to them the sound of the Lord God walking in the garden in the evening wind: and the man and his wife went to a secret place among the trees of the garden, away from the eyes of the Lord God.

verses.en: And the LORD God called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where art thou?
verses.pt: E o SENHOR Deus chamou ao homem, e lhe disse: “Onde estás?
verses.en_web: Yahweh God called to the man, and said to him, “Where are you?”
verses.en_bbe: And the voice of the Lord God came to the man, saying, Where are you?

verses.en: And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.
verses.pt: E ele respondeu: “Ouvi tua voz no jardim, e tive medo, porque estava nu; e me escondi”.
verses.en_web: The man said, “I heard your voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, Hearing your voice in the garden I was full of fear, because I was without clothing: and I kept myself from your eyes.

verses.en: And he said, Who told thee that thou wast naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?
verses.pt: E disse-lhe: “Quem te ensinou que estavas nu? Comeste da árvore de que te mandei que não comesses?”
verses.en_web: God said, “Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from?”
verses.en_bbe: And he said, Who gave you the knowledge that you were without clothing? Have you taken of the fruit of the tree which I said you were not to take?

verses.en: And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.
verses.pt: E o homem respondeu: “A mulher que me deste por companheira me deu da árvore, e eu comi”.
verses.en_web: The man said, “The woman whom you gave to be with me, she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate it.”
verses.en_bbe: And the man said, The woman whom you gave to be with me, she gave me the fruit of the tree and I took it.

verses.en: And the LORD God said unto the woman, What is this that thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.
verses.pt: Então o SENHOR Deus disse à mulher: “Por que fizeste isto?” E a mulher disse: “A serpente me enganou, e comi”.
verses.en_web: Yahweh God said to the woman, “What have you done?” The woman said, “The serpent deceived me, and I ate.”
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord God said to the woman, What have you done? And the woman said, I was tricked by the deceit of the snake and I took it.

verses.en: And the LORD God said unto the serpent, Because thou hast done this, thou art cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life:
verses.pt: E o SENHOR Deus disse à serpente: “Porque fizeste isto, maldita serás entre todos os animais selvagens e entre todos os animais do campo; sobre teu ventre andarás, e pó comerás todos os dias da tua vida.
verses.en_web: Yahweh God said to the serpent, “Because you have done this, you are cursed above all livestock, and above every animal of the field. You shall go on your belly and you shall eat dust all the days of your life.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord God said to the snake, Because you have done this you are cursed more than all cattle and every beast of the field; you will go flat on the earth, and dust will be your food all the days of your life:

verses.en: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.
verses.pt: E porei inimizade entre ti e a mulher, e entre tua descendência e a descendência dela; esta te ferirá a cabeça, e tu lhe ferirás o calcanhar”.
verses.en_web: I will put hostility between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring. He will bruise your head, and you will bruise his heel.”
verses.en_bbe: And there will be war between you and the woman and between your seed and her seed: by him will your head be crushed and by you his foot will be wounded.

verses.en: Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.
verses.pt: E para a mulher disse: “Multiplicarei grandemente as tuas dores e teus sofrimentos de parto; com dor darás à luz filhos; e o teu desejo será para o teu marido, e ele te dominará”.
verses.en_web: To the woman he said, “I will greatly multiply your pain in childbirth. In pain you will bear children. Your desire will be for your husband, and he will rule over you.”
verses.en_bbe: To the woman he said, Great will be your pain in childbirth; in sorrow will your children come to birth; still your desire will be for your husband, but he will be your master.

verses.en: And unto Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying, Thou shalt not eat of it: cursed is the ground for thy sake; in sorrow shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life;
verses.pt: E ao homem disse: “Porque deste ouvidos à voz de tua mulher, e comeste da árvore de que te mandei dizendo, ‘Não comerás dela’, maldita será a terra por causa de ti; com dor comerás dela todos os dias da tua vida;
verses.en_web: To Adam he said, “Because you have listened to your wife’s voice, and ate from the tree, about which I commanded you, saying, ‘You shall not eat of it,’ the ground is cursed for your sake. You will eat from it with much labor all the days of your life.
verses.en_bbe: And to Adam he said, Because you gave ear to the voice of your wife and took of the fruit of the tree which I said you were not to take, the earth is cursed on your account; in pain you will get your food from it all your life.

verses.en: Thorns also and thistles shall it bring forth to thee; and thou shalt eat the herb of the field;
verses.pt: Espinhos e cardos te produzirá, e comerás erva do campo.
verses.en_web: It will yield thorns and thistles to you; and you will eat the herb of the field.
verses.en_bbe: Thorns and waste plants will come up, and the plants of the field will be your food;

verses.en: In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.
verses.pt: No suor do teu rosto comerás o pão até que voltes à terra, porque dela foste tomado; porque pó és, e ao pó voltarás”.
verses.en_web: By the sweat of your face will you eat bread until you return to the ground, for out of it you were taken. For you are dust, and to dust you shall return.”
verses.en_bbe: With the hard work of your hands you will get your bread till you go back to the earth from which you were taken: for dust you are and to the dust you will go back.

verses.en: And Adam called his wife’s name Eve; because she was the mother of all living.
verses.pt: E chamou o homem o nome de sua mulher, Eva; porquanto ela era mãe de todos o viventes.
verses.en_web: The man called his wife Eve because she would be the mother of all the living.
verses.en_bbe: And the man gave his wife the name of Eve because she was the mother of all who have life.

verses.en: Unto Adam also and to his wife did the LORD God make coats of skins, and clothed them.
verses.pt: E o SENHOR Deus fez ao homem e à sua mulher túnicas de peles, e os vestiu.
verses.en_web: Yahweh God made coats of animal skins for Adam and for his wife, and clothed them.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord God made for Adam and for his wife coats of skins for their clothing.

verses.en: And the LORD God said, Behold, the man is become as one of us, to know good and evil: and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever:
verses.pt: E disse o SENHOR Deus: Eis que o homem é como um de Nos sabendo o bem e o mal; agora, pois, para que não estenda sua mão, e tome também da árvore da vida, e coma, e viva para sempre:
verses.en_web: Yahweh God said, “Behold, the man has become like one of us, knowing good and evil. Now, lest he reach out his hand, and also take of the tree of life, and eat, and live forever—”
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord God said, Now the man has become like one of us, having knowledge of good and evil; and now if he puts out his hand and takes of the fruit of the tree of life, he will go on living for ever.

verses.en: Therefore the LORD God sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.
verses.pt: E tirou-o o SENHOR do jardim de Éden, para que lavrasse a terra de que foi tomado.
verses.en_web: Therefore Yahweh God sent him out from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from which he was taken.
verses.en_bbe: So the Lord God sent him out of the garden of Eden to be a worker on the earth from which he was taken.

verses.en: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubim, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.
verses.pt: Lançou, pois, fora ao homem, e pôs ao oriente do jardim de Éden querubins, e uma espada acesa que se revolvia a todos os lados, para guardar o caminho da árvore da vida.
verses.en_web: So he drove out the man; and he placed cherubim at the east of the garden of Eden, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to guard the way to the tree of life.
verses.en_bbe: So he sent the man out; and at the east of the garden of Eden he put winged ones and a flaming sword turning every way to keep the way to the tree of life.
